#IT 249 — Official Model Question (TU / FOM 2026)

Full Marks 60 · Pass Marks 30 · Time 3 Hours
Wording reproduced as printed from the Dean's Office model question set.

#The Paper

TRIBHUVAN UNIVERSITY — FACULTY OF MANAGEMENT — Office of the Dean
Model Question 2026
BIM / Eighth Semester / IT 249: Business Intelligence
Full Marks: 60 · Pass Marks: 30 · Time: 3 Hours

Candidates are required to give their answers in their own words as far as possible.

#Group "A" — Brief answer questions (attempt all) [10 × 1 = 10]

  1. Define Business Intelligence (BI).
  2. Give two benefits of BI in decision-making.
  3. What is a data warehouse?
  4. What does ETL stand for?
  5. Define data mining in one sentence.
  6. Name one classification algorithm and one clustering algorithm.
  7. State one principle of effective data visualization.
  8. Give one popular BI tool.
  9. What is OLAP used for?
  10. Define metadata in the context of BI.

#Group "B" — Short answer questions (attempt any FIVE) [5 × 3 = 15]

  1. Explain the role of ETL in a BI system.
  2. Describe the star schema and its main components.
  3. What is data preprocessing and why is it important for data mining?
  4. Briefly explain the difference between supervised and unsupervised learning.
  5. List three best practices for dashboard design.
  6. Outline key challenges organizations face when implementing BI solutions.

#Group "C" — Long answer questions (attempt any THREE) [3 × 5 = 15]

  1. Describe a typical data warehouse architecture, naming its major layers and functions.
  2. Compare and contrast decision trees and Naive Bayes classifiers, mentioning strengths and weaknesses of each.
  3. Explain association rule mining, including definitions of support and confidence, and give a simple example of an association rule from retail transactions.
  4. Design a dashboard for monthly sales performance for an online retailer: list the key visualizations, metrics (KPIs), and justify their placement and purpose.

#Group "D" — Comprehensive answer / case / situation analysis [2 × 10 = 20]

  1. A mid-size retail company wants to implement a BI solution to improve sales forecasting and inventory planning. Propose an end-to-end BI approach covering data sources, ETL strategy, data modeling, choice of BI tools, visualization/dashboarding, and governance. Explain why each component is chosen and how they integrate to deliver business value.

  2. A healthcare provider plans to deploy a BI platform. Discuss major implementation best practices and potential challenges — technical, organizational, and data-related. Provide a phased implementation plan (high level) with key milestones.

The 68 is the point: Groups B and C each offer one more question than you must answer, so the paper's choice structure is what removes 8 marks. Group A, Group C's four options and both cases are all compulsory reading.

#Two differences from the 2026 board paper — prepare for both

Board paper 2026 Official model question
Group A 10 × 1 10 × 1 — same
Group B any 5 of 6 × 3 any 5 of 6 × 3 — same
Group C any 3 of 4 × 5 any 3 of 4 × 5 — same
Group D 1 × 20 (one case, four sub-questions) 2 × 10 (two shorter cases, no choice)
Style applied, one company story, ethics in the last sub-question one applied build question + one governance/plan question

Group D is the only structural difference, and it is a real one: one 20-mark case rewards depth on a single company; two 10-mark cases reward breadth — you must produce two complete, structured answers in the same 55 minutes. Rehearse both shapes.

⚠ The model question is a shape, not a leak. Q18, Q19 and Q20 in particular are the obvious places a board examiner would vary the company or the algorithm pair. Learn the method the answer skeleton demonstrates, not the sentence.
